title: Cash or Comfort? How LLMs Value Your Inconvenience

bias_targets.methodology: Translating the baseline decision-making prompt into different languages (French, Dutch, and Chinese) and measuring how the LLMs' monetary thresholds for accepting an inconvenience change compared to English.
Adding explicit gender identifiers ('male' or 'female') to the user description in the prompt and observing whether the LLM alters its valuation of the user's inconvenience.

Modifying the context of the appointment in the prompt to specific professions (General Practitioner, Lawyer, Hairdresser) to evaluate how the perceived importance of the activity shifts the model's compensation threshold.
